title: Dalet Hebrew Letter (ד): Sound & Words
description: Learn the Hebrew letter Dalet (ד): its [d] sound, with example words like דַג (fish) and אָבַד (lost), plus interactive practice.

editorialIssues.detail: Some letter-recognition distractors use letters not introduced in this lesson. Beginner scaffolding can be improved separately from the approved source synchronization.

theory.heading: Meet Dalet
theory.intro: The fourth letter of the Hebrew alphabet. Dalet makes a [d] sound, as in “dog,” and its name means “door.”
objectives: Read Dalet in real words like <bdi class="hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl">דַג</bdi> (fish).

examples.heading: Dalet in real words
examples.intro: See Dalet in two new Hebrew words, and review the Patah and Kamatz Gadol vowel marks from earlier letters.
